title: UFOs appeared the day after the Fukushima disaster
summary: Jesse Michels tells of UFOs appeared the day after the Fukushima disaster, about 2011 at Japan (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
So when there was the
Fukushima disaster, they showed up
the next day.
Um but UFOs were reported to show up around the nuclear disaster.
tellings.difference: Says only that UFOs were reported around the disaster, without the 'next day' timing.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of UFOs showing up around the 2011 Fukushima nuclear disaster.

as_told.title: UFOs reported around the Fukushima nuclear disaster

tellings.quote: literally this monk at this Shinto temple in uh Fukushima and when they had their 2011 famous nuclear spill due to the earthquake, he was like the the UFO showed up and cleaned up the temple.
tellings.difference: Adds that a Shinto temple monk saw the UFO, and that it cleaned up the temple.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same Fukushima 2011 event where UFOs reportedly showed up after the nuclear disaster, told by the same host.

as_told.title: UFO cleans up Shinto temple after Fukushima nuclear disaster

tellings.quote: >> there's a video though from that disaster where UFOs are everywhere and it's almost like they're doing cleanup
tellings.difference: Cites a video and says the UFOs seemed to be doing cleanup.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about UFOs showing up around the 2011 Fukushima disaster.

as_told.title: Video of UFOs during the Fukushima disaster

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that UFOs showed up the day after the Fukushima disaster, the 2011 nuclear accident at a power plant in Japan. In a later episode he puts it more loosely, saying only that UFOs were reported around the disaster. He tells it because, if true, it would suggest these objects take a special interest in nuclear sites and nuclear trouble.
